documentation.content: Runbook row: SQL availability and capacity (MONITORING-RUNBOOK.md, Current-service signal plan). Responder: on-call API responder. Warns at 80% of the deployment's reserved connection ceiling (infra/deployment.json: max_connections 100 minus superuser_reserved_connections 3 minus surge_allowance_connections 10 = 87; 80% of 87 rounds to 70), per the runbook's instruction to apply the connection reserve policy rather than a guessed universal count. Initial, review after 7 days.
